name: Dropdown Menu
hint: Open Share, then cut diagonally to its submenu. Type a letter to jump.
description: Action menu with nested submenus, checkbox items and typeahead. A safe triangle from the pointer to the submenu keeps it open while you cut diagonally across other items.
usage: Use for a list of actions behind one button (row actions, an overflow menu). Pass `items` as plain objects {id, label, icon, shortcut, disabled, danger, items (submenu), type:'checkbox'}, with {separator:true} between groups and {type:'label', label} for a group heading, and handle `onSelect(id, item)`. Labels are strings. The menu closes on select unless `closeOnSelect` is false. Swap the button with `trigger`, control it with `open` / `onOpenChange`, and hold checkbox state with `checked` / `onCheckedChange`. Keep to 3 levels and put destructive actions last.

keyboard.does: Opens the menu with focus on the first item.
Opens the menu with focus on the last item.
Moves to the next or previous item, skipping disabled items and wrapping at the ends.
Moves to the first or last item.
Moves to the next item whose label starts with that letter; letters typed quickly match a longer start.
Chooses the item, closes the menu and returns focus to the button.
Ticks or unticks the item and keeps the menu open.
Opens the submenu and moves to its first item.
keyboard.when: on an item with a submenu

keyboard.does: Closes the submenu and returns to the item that opened it.
Closes the menu and returns focus to the button.
Closes the menu and leaves focus on the button.
Opens the submenu in place of the list, with a Back row first that returns to the level above.

screenReader: The button has aria-haspopup="menu", aria-expanded and aria-controls, and is named by `label` (or by your `trigger`'s own name). The menu is role menu named by `label`; items are menuitem, checkbox items menuitemcheckbox with aria-checked, items with a submenu carry aria-haspopup and aria-expanded, and disabled items aria-disabled. A chosen item's label is said through a polite live region.

dataProps.type: Array<{ id?: string; label: string; icon?: string; shortcut?: string; disabled?: boolean; danger?: boolean; type?: "checkbox"; closeOnSelect?: boolean; onSelect?: () => void; items?: Array<{ id?: string; label: string; icon?: string; shortcut?: string; disabled?: boolean; danger?: boolean; type?: "checkbox"; closeOnSelect?: boolean; onSelect?: () => void; items?: Array<{ id?: string; label: string; icon?: string; shortcut?: string; disabled?: boolean; danger?: boolean; type?: "checkbox"; closeOnSelect?: boolean; onSelect?: () => void } | { separator: true } | { type: "separator" } | { type: "label" | "group"; label: string } | null> } | { separator: true } | { type: "separator" } | { type: "label" | "group"; label: string } | null> } | { separator: true } | { type: "separator" } | { type: "label" | "group"; label: string } | null>
dataProps.description: [{ id, label, icon, shortcut, disabled, danger, items, type: 'checkbox', closeOnSelect }], plus { separator: true } and { type: 'label', label } for group headings. Empty by default; with no items the menu does not open. `icon` is an icon name; the type spells out three levels of submenu, and deeper levels take the same shape.

dataProps.type: (id: string, item: { id?: string; label: string; icon?: string; shortcut?: string; disabled?: boolean; danger?: boolean; type?: "checkbox"; closeOnSelect?: boolean; onSelect?: () => void }) => void
dataProps.description: (id, item) => void when an item is chosen (not for checkbox items or submenu parents). id falls back to the label when an item has none.
Text of the built-in trigger button; also the menu's accessible name.
Icon before the label on the built-in trigger, or "none".

dataProps.type: node | ((props: { ref: (el: HTMLElement | null) => void; onClick: () => void; onKeyDown: (event: { key: string; preventDefault: () => void }) => void; disabled?: boolean; open: boolean; "aria-haspopup": "menu"; "aria-expanded": boolean; "aria-controls"?: string }) => node)
dataProps.description: Your own trigger: an element (cloned with ref, onClick, onKeyDown and aria attributes) or (props) => node spreading { ref, onClick, onKeyDown, disabled, aria-haspopup, aria-expanded }.
(open: boolean, reason) => void; reason is "trigger", "select", "escape" (Escape or Tab) or "outside".
Close after an item is chosen. An item's own closeOnSelect wins.
Escape closes the menu (it still closes an open submenu).
A press outside closes the menu.
Initial checkbox state when uncontrolled. `defaultChecks` is the older name and still works.
Older name for `defaultChecked`, kept so existing code works. Use `defaultChecked`.

dataProps.type: (id: string, checked: boolean, all: Record<string, boolean>) => void
dataProps.description: (id, checked, all) => void when a checkbox item is toggled.
The trigger button. className, style and other props go to it too.

Where the menu renders. true: through a portal into document.body, carrying the theme tokens found at the trigger, so an ancestor with overflow:hidden, transform, filter or backdrop-filter can't clip or move it (it still opens above a Modal or Drawer it sits in, and stays part of it for focus and outside presses). false: in place inside the component, as before. An element or ref: portaled into that element instead.
Any other attribute (id, aria-*, data-*) goes to the menu's <button>, and so do className and style, merged with the button's own.

example:
<DropdownMenu
  label="More"
  placement="bottom-end"
  items={[
    { id: "rename", label: "Rename", icon: "edit", shortcut: "F2" },
    { id: "copy", label: "Copy link", icon: "link" },
    { separator: true },
    { id: "delete", label: "Delete", icon: "trash", danger: true },
  ]}
  onSelect={(id) => run(id)}
/>

{/* your own trigger, controlled checkboxes */}
<DropdownMenu
  trigger={(props) => <Button {...props} variant="ghost" label="View" />}
  items={[{ type: "label", label: "Show" }, { id: "grid", label: "Grid", type: "checkbox" }]}
  checked={view}
  onCheckedChange={(id, on) => setView((v) => ({ ...v, [id]: on }))}
/>
